Game Overview

In Cyberpunk - Resistance, the core idea is straightforward: command your resistance squad in a chaotic urban dystopia, strategically battling relentless robotic police. Navigate through vivid cyberpunk environments, utilizing cover, teamwork, and an arsenal of powerful weapons. With enemies constantly evolving, your survival hinges on strategy, precision, and relentless action-packed combat. Are you ready to fight back?
